name: Lübbecke (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lübbecke (a red castle with a star and crossed keys on white).
history: The right to bear these arms, a flag and a seal was granted to the city by the Regierungspräsident on 7 October 1974; the flag shows the arms on a red and white striped flag.

features.role: Lübbecke arms — castle with star and keys
